description: This file defines models and methods related to account fiscal positions and partner financial data in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including mappings for taxes and accounts, and partner financial calculations.

classes.name: account_fiscal_position
classes.description: Model for managing fiscal position configurations, including tax and account mappings.

classes.name: account_fiscal_position_tax
classes.description: Model for mapping taxes within a fiscal position.

classes.name: account_fiscal_position_account
classes.description: Model for mapping accounts within a fiscal position.

classes.name: res_partner
classes.description: Extension of the partner model to include financial properties and calculations.

methods.name: map_tax
methods.description: Maps source taxes to destination taxes based on fiscal position.

methods.name: map_account
methods.description: Maps an account ID to its fiscal position equivalent.

methods.name: _credit_debit_get
methods.description: Calculates total receivable and payable amounts for partners.

methods.name: _asset_difference_search
methods.description: Searches partners based on asset differences, used for receivable/payable filtering.
